newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on exports, firm cash.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on exports, firm cash.

text.p: Greater than expected weekly exports of U.S. rice plus firm cash markets boosted CBOT rice futures to a higher close, traders said.
"Exports were better than expected," a trader said.
USDA Thursday said the U.S. rice net export sales for the week ended October 24 were at 61,300 tonnes, 82 percent above the previous week and 17 percent above the four-week average.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, up from 371 Wednesday.
Rice futures closed six to 12 cents per cwt higher, with November up 12 at $10.01.
